data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘Aelfric’, meaning ‘elf ruler’ or ‘noble elf’. In Christian tradition, Alyworth represents courage and devotion. The name Alyworth carries the meaning “Elf or noble” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alyworth usually hope their child will grow to embody elf or noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
